# JobQueueOptions.name property

Name of the job queue. Required.

This is the queue's identity, not a label: a [JobQueueWorker](/api/job/latest/job.jobqueueworker/) and a [JobQueuePublisher](/api/job/latest/job.jobqueuepublisher/) that share a name are two ends of one queue, and two that do not are unrelated queues that will never see each other's jobs.

**Signature:**

```typescript
name: string;
```
